name: Fill in the Blank (Word Bank)
summary: Sentence with blanks + word bank. Tap/drag words into blanks. Cloze with scaffolding.

aiGenerability.notes: AI generates sentences, identifies key terms, creates distractors. Given a content passage or topic, AI can create cloze sentences with word banks automatically. Distractors should be semantically or syntactically plausible but contextually incorrect.

text.description: Sentence or passage with {{blank}} placeholders indicating where words should be inserted.

correctAnswer.description: The correct word to fill this blank.

position.description: 0-based position of this blank in the text (for tracking).

wordBank.description: Array of word options including correct answers and distractors. Count should be number of blanks + 2-3 distractors.

explanation.description: Optional explanation of the context and correct answers after completion.

difficulty.description: Difficulty based on context clues and distractor plausibility.

ux.animation: word-snap-into-blank with color highlight, shake on incorrect placement, fade-out for used words
ux.mobileNotes: Text passage displayed prominently, blanks shown as underlines or boxes. Word bank below as draggable/tappable tiles. Words are initially all available; when placed, they may gray-out or disappear from bank. Tap blank to remove placed word.

ageAdaptations.8-10: 1 blank maximum, 2-3 words in bank. Simple, short sentence (10-15 words total). Very obvious context clues. Words in bank are visually distinct from each other. Large text (16-18pt). Tap-to-fill interaction (less drag dexterity required).
ageAdaptations.11-13: 2 blanks, 4-5 words in bank. Longer sentences (15-25 words). Context clues present but require reading comprehension. Standard 14-16pt text. Drag-and-drop or tap interaction both supported. Immediate per-blank feedback.
ageAdaptations.14-16: 3+ blanks, 6-8 words in bank. Complex passages (25-50 words). Minimal context clues; requires vocabulary knowledge and syntactic awareness. Distractors are semantically similar (synonyms, near-misses). Small, compact text. Drag interaction required. Can include multiple-sentence passages.
